record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The four units in appliesTo declare EXPLOSION in this production reference. The strategy is a shared constant instance (explosionStrategy); differences between the units are star count, stats and maxPP.

dispatch.registry: AbilityStrategies[Ability.EXPLOSION] = explosionStrategy (the constant `export const explosionStrategy = new ExplosionStrategy()` in explosion.ts)

record.summary: Area self-centred special damage: every unit of the other team standing in the 8 cells around the caster takes SPECIAL damage (raw 50/100/200/400 by caster stars), and the caster then damages itself with the same raw amount unless it holds Protective Pads.

targeting.who: enemy units in the cells adjacent to the caster (not adjacent to the cast target)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true, so the caster still needs a target in range to cast; the target parameter is only used by super.process for the animation and is not used for the damage. How the target is picked before the cast was not read.

geometry.shape: the 8 board cells around the caster (3x3 minus centre), clipped to the board; allies and empty cells are skipped

effects.target: each enemy in the adjacent cells
effects.scaling: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); the crit flag multiplies by critPower (reduced by the target's crit reduction) only if the cast rolled a crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT because canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: requested = the raw amount; after handleSpecialDamage AP/crit scaling the target's SPE_DEF division (damage / (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF), ceil, min 1) and later untraced modifiers; a target with protect / skydiving / magicBounce takes none (takenDamage 0). Damage lands on a shield first (whole amount unless flinched); a Protective Pads holder doubles the amount that hits a shield. The strategy does not read takenDamage, so applied damage does not feed back into the ability.

effects.target: the caster itself, skipped if it holds PROTECTIVE_PADS
effects.scaling: same raw amount; handleSpecialDamage is called with the caster as attacker, so the caster's own AP (and crit) scale it, then the caster's own SPE_DEF applies
effects.resolution: requested = the raw amount; applied = after the caster's AP/crit, its own SPE_DEF division (ceil, min 1) and its shield; blocked if the caster has protect / skydiving / magicBounce. The caster is not guaranteed to survive; its death handling was not traced.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value (400, also the fallback) is not reachable by the four units' bare star counts. maxPP and range are in appliesTo.

record.positionalConditions: Damages only enemies currently occupying one of the cells touching the caster; if none, only the caster's self-damage (unless Protective Pads) occurs. Cell contents are read at cast time.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast repeats the area damage and the self-damage (the caster's pp is reset by super.process).
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: 50/100/200/400 by caster stars (the same number for enemies and for the caster). Dealt = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor], then the receiver's SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1) and untraced modifiers; shield damage counts as damage taken. Requested, applied and takenDamage are not reported by this strategy.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (items such as Poke Doll, synergy effects, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers); only the SPECIAL SPE_DEF division, the minimum of 1 and the shield step were read
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, target selection before the cast, silence); only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Death handling of a caster that kills itself with its own explosion (and whether deaths inside the loop change later cells)
unresolved: Routing uncertainty CONSTANT_STRATEGY: the ability is registered through the shared constant explosionStrategy; this record reads the constant's class in explosion.ts and found no other definition, but other registrations of the same constant were not searched
Whether any item or synergy effect other than Protective Pads changes EXPLOSION
Units not listed in appliesTo that might share the identifier are not covered
